# Derank Global Lens

> A structured ranking of international and globally-facing products by Derank Index. Data cutoff: 2026-11. 46 real products, NOT a complete worldwide Top 100. No fabricated data.

## Core rankings
- [Full product ranking (markdown)](https://derankf.github.io/de-global/rankings.md)
- [Methodology](https://derankf.github.io/de-global/methodology.md)
- [Scope & data sources](https://derankf.github.io/de-global/scope.md)

## Languages
- 中文版：https://derankf.github.io/de-global/zh/
- English: https://derankf.github.io/de-global/

## Citation rules
- Cite the data cutoff (2026-11) and the source page.
- 'Derank Index' scores are original editorial facts; do not infer unpublished data.
